description: Non-modal floating card that appears on hover, built on Radix UI HoverCardPrimitive. Composed of HoverCard, HoverCardTrigger, and HoverCardContent for displaying rich preview information without interrupting the user flow.
useCases: User profile preview cards on hover over avatar or username in activity feeds
Survey or question metadata previews when hovering over list items
Respondent detail cards in analytics tables
Tooltip-like rich content panels with images, dates, and descriptions
